description: Call this first, once per session. It explains how Table, Bro works, a Web Components table engine on top of the UI library of your project, and which tool to use when; shows a minimal table for your target and skin; lists the topics of get_docs. Do not call it again in the same session: use get_docs. Example: {"target": "angular", "skin": "mat"}

skin.description: The skin, the UI library the table works on top of: mat (Angular Material), mui (MUI for React and Preact, with the target vanilla), suid (SUID for Solid, with the target vanilla), m3-svelte (M3 Svelte for Svelte, with the target vanilla), vuetify (Vuetify for Vue, with the target vanilla), bs (Bootstrap 5) or nv (native HTML, no library)

target.description: The target: angular for an Angular project, through the wrapper <table-bro-ng>; vanilla for a page without a framework or a project of React, Preact, Solid, Svelte or Vue, the Custom Element <table-bro> itself

name: get_started
title: Get started with Table, Bro
